findings.description: Every product card on the product list shows the same dog photo instead of its own product photo (all six images point to the same asset).
repro: Sign in as customer-447e
Look at the six product cards on /inventory.html
Observe that all six images are identical

findings.description: Choosing Remove on a product card does not remove it: the button stays as Remove and the cart badge stays at 2.
repro: Sign in as customer-447e
Choose Add to basket on Sauce Labs Backpack and Sauce Labs Bike Light; badge shows 2
Choose Remove on Sauce Labs Bike Light
Observe the button still reads Remove and the badge still shows 2

findings.description: Only Name (A to Z) sorts correctly. Choosing Name (Z to A), Price (low to high) or Price (high to low) leaves the list in the A to Z order and the dropdown snaps back to Name (A to Z).
repro: Sign in as customer-447e
Open the sort dropdown and choose Name (Z to A)
Observe the list order is unchanged and the dropdown shows Name (A to Z)
Repeat with Price (low to high) and Price (high to low)

findings.description: The product detail page shows 'Sauce Labs Backpack' as the name for every product, regardless of which product was opened from the list.
repro: Sign in as customer-447e
Choose the name of Sauce Labs Bike Light on /inventory.html
Observe the detail page title reads Sauce Labs Backpack
Repeat for other products

findings.description: Detail pages show the wrong price and description for products. For example, the list product Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red) at $15.99 opens as the Backpack at $29.99 with the Backpack description and photo, and the Fleece Jacket ($49.99) detail shows $29.99.
repro: Sign in as customer-447e
Choose Test.allTheThings() T-Shirt (Red) on /inventory.html and note its $15.99 price
Observe the detail page shows Backpack, $29.99 and the Backpack description
Choose Sauce Labs Fleece Jacket ($49.99) and observe the detail page shows $29.99

findings.description: The Last Name field cannot be filled: text typed into it lands in the First Name field and the Last Name field stays empty, so Continue fails with 'Last Name is required' and checkout is blocked.
repro: Sign in as customer-447e and add a product to the cart
Choose Checkout
Type Ann into First Name, Tester into Last Name, and 12345 into Zip/Postal Code
Observe First Name reads Tester, Last Name is empty, and Continue shows 'Error: Last Name is required'

notes: Tested login, product list layout, add to cart on the list and detail page, cart contents, cart remove, Continue Shopping and logout. Logout redirects correctly. Not tested: checkout overview totals and tax, the confirmation page and Back Home, because the Last Name bug blocks checkout. Also not tested: the Add to basket label where the brief says Add to cart, which I treated as deliberate copy and did not report.

cost.notes: estimate from 93243 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0009-$0.0112
